trees.why: absolute pressure is the strongest single signal (rain rate 65% -> 13% across quintiles); graded

falling in the last 6h (despite the evening pressure tide) = front arriving now
persistence, graded by how much it rained today
rain still falling in the evening (67% rain tomorrow)
clear day overall (overlaps evening cloud, small weight)
dry evening air is a dry signal; very humid air adds nothing extra (plateau)
large dew-point spread = dry air mass
southerly flow brings moist air (47% vs 21% northerly)
